text: {"version":1,"kind":"analytics","reading":"Total gross profit (pretax order subtotal minus order supply cost) for calendar year 2025, together with gross margin as a percentage of pretax revenue.","measures":[{"ref":"column:dev.orders.subtotal","aggregation":"sum","alias":"revenue_2025"},{"ref":"column:dev.orders.order_cost","aggregation":"sum","alias":"cost_2025"},{"derived":{"kind":"ratio","numerator":"column:dev.orders.order_cost","numeratorAggregation":"sum","denominator":"column:dev.orders.subtotal","denominatorAggregation":"sum"},"alias":"cost_to_revenue_ratio_2025"}],"groupBy":[],"display":[],"filters":[],"time":{"ref":"column:dev.orders.ordered_at","window":{"start":"2025-01-01","end":"2026-01-01","expression":"in 2025"}},"expectedShape":"comparison","unresolved":[{"clause":"gross profit and gross margin percentage","options":["column:dev.orders.subtotal","column:dev.orders.order_cost"],"material":false,"question":"No governed gross-profit metric exists; gross profit = sum(subtotal) - sum(order_cost) and gross margin % = 1 - cost_to_revenue_ratio_2025 (i.e. (revenue - cost) / revenue), derived from the two column sums above."}],"provenance":{"column:dev.orders.subtotal":"q:gross profit / gross margin percentage","column:dev.orders.order_cost":"q:gross profit / gross margin percentage","column:dev.orders.ordered_at":"q:in 2025"}}
